name: fatorx-global-intelligence
description: Monorepo do Fator X Global Intelligence

scripts.lint:python: uv run ruff check apps src tests scripts
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:python && pnpm lint:web && pnpm secrets
scripts.format: uv run ruff format apps src tests scripts && pnpm --filter @fatorx/web format
scripts.format:check: uv run ruff format --check apps src tests scripts && pnpm --filter @fatorx/web format:check
scripts.typecheck:python: uv run mypy apps/api src tests scripts
scripts.quality: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
